## King of Snipers

Usopp's father Yasopp can shoot the antenna off an ant. Usopp lies about doing better, and sometimes does.

Fight as a Sniper and carry a bow, a slingshot or a gun.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Fight as a Sniper](st_sniper.md#q-463b26df2066f201)

**Tasks**

- Carry a ranged weapon

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +5 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-3df7e409774613b9"></a>

## Kemuri Boshi

A good sniper never needs to win a fair fight.

Unlock Kemuri Boshi. Sniper trainers run Accuracy trials that pay Training Points.

## Boin Archipelago

Usopp spent two years on an island where every plant wanted to eat him, and came back with a pocket full of seeds.

Land on a jungle island in Paradise, Defeat 20 hostiles in Paradise and unlock Sakuretsu Saboten Boshi.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Kemuri Boshi](st_sniper.md#q-3df7e409774613b9)

**Tasks**

- Land on a jungle island in Paradise
- Defeat 20 hostiles in Paradise
- Unlock Sakuretsu Saboten Boshi

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, +8 Training Points (your style)
